title: [finding] Two bare-root-worklist TRIAGE rows cite collapseHint values the function does not produce — one of them misattributes its own REFUSE to the wrong mechanism
body:
Blocked-by: #12328

Found while measuring #12246 (the mid-segment glob collapse). ⛔ Not fixed there — that card's
declared surface is `collapseHint` and its `--self-test`, and its dispatch explicitly ruled the
TRIAGE rows out of scope ("Measuring whether it becomes retirable is in scope; changing it is
not"). Filed unassigned, not graded.

Both rows live in `scripts/pm/bare-root-worklist.mjs` and were landed by PR #12247.

> **⚠️ STATUS (PM seat #6023, 2026-08-25).** Row 1 is **repaired and landed** by PR #12330
> (`cf99875ea8`). Row 2 is **not**, and is not a dev's to take: post-#12300 its narrow spelling
> `skills/*/references/**` covers **exactly 12** tracked files — precisely that row's own stated
> population, 9 of them the `_index.md` it emits — so its conclusion "the only spellable claim left
> is the bare root" is false on this tree and `REFUSE-UNSPELLABLE` no longer describes it.
> Repairing the quoted value while the verdict stands would ship a row whose reason argues against
> its own verdict; changing the verdict is a re-decision on a **shrink-only** map, reserved by this
> card, by the dispatch, and by the file's own docblock alike. The class — this row plus two more
> found by sweeping — is **#12328**, with the full measured table and options A/B/C. This card
> stays open and blocked so that the unrepaired half is not hidden by a closed card.

## 1. `check:runner-env-posture SCANNED_ROOTS packages` — substantive

The row (`:325-330`) reads:

> `packages/**/src/**` is the true population and collapseHint reduces it to `packages`, so the
> only spellable claim also names every package manifest, changelog, fixture and the 2746 test
> files this gate deliberately skips

Measured on `fb5fbb8514`:

```
collapseHint('packages/**/src/**')  ->  'packages//src'   reaches 0 tracked files
a collapse to 'packages' would have reached                    5225 tracked files
```

`collapseHint` does **not** reduce it to `packages`. The `**` deletions leave `packages//src`, and
the trailing-anchored strips (`/\/+$/`) cannot touch a double slash left mid-string — so the hint
is **dead**, not over-broad.

The verdict `REFUSE-UNSPELLABLE` survives, but its stated mechanism is the wrong one. As written
the row describes an over-claim that does not happen; the real reason this population is
unspellable is the #12246 double-slash defect. A reader pricing the row (or deciding whether it
becomes retirable) is reading a cost model for a collapse the function never performs.

⚠️ **Superseded by measurement (#12330):** the mechanism above is itself wrong post-#12300.
`hintCovers` short-circuits a glob in a non-final segment to `triggerCovers` before `collapseHint`
is ever called, so the hint is **live**, not dead — and the refusal survives on the file-KIND
filter rather than the segment. That is what PR #12330 landed.

## 2. `check:skill-refs SKILLS_DIR skills` — cosmetic

The row (`:316-324`) reads `collapseHint` reduces `skills/*/references/**` to
`skills//references/**`. Measured:

```
collapseHint('skills/*/references/**')  ->  'skills//references'   reaches 0
```

The trailing `/**` is stripped; the cited value keeps it. The double-slash point — the substance,
and the row's correct citation of #12246 — is unaffected.

⚠️ **Also superseded:** this row is not cosmetic. See the STATUS block above.

## Why this is worth a row of its own

Both rows are in fact instances of the *same* defect (#12246), and #2 says so by number. #1 does
not, and misreads it as the collapse-to-root case instead. That matters because the two have
opposite remedies: a collapse-to-root over-claim is fixed by narrowing a declaration, while a
dead double slash is fixed in the covering rule and cannot be declared around at all.

`scripts/pm/bare-root-worklist.mjs --self-test` is green across both rows (`46 live row(s), 39
unreachable as spelled, 39 recorded verdict(s) — none stale, none missing`), because the self-test
reconciles row *keys* and reachability, not the prose of `why`. That is the same shape as the
closed #11277, one file over — a recorded verdict whose measurement text is wrong while the
machinery that would catch a wrong *key* stays green.

## Not asserted

No claim that either verdict should change. Both are `REFUSE-UNSPELLABLE` and both look correct
under the measured behaviour; what is wrong is the reason text. Re-deciding a TRIAGE verdict is a
separate judgment call and is deliberately not proposed here.

Refs: #12246 (the defect both rows are instances of) · #12247 (landed both rows) · #11277 (closed;
same species, different row) · #12064 (adjacent worklist-output defect, different mechanism) ·
#12300 (the change that falsified both rows' stated mechanism) · #12328 (the class, where row 2
now lives) · PR #12330 (row 1's repair)
